summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.20/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.20 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 17, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since May 28. AAA figures put the statewide average 14¢ higher than a week ago, 21¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.22 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.88) and the highest in Marshfield ($4.49).
